This table shows the typical number of customer-boardings made on each subway line and the number of customers travelling to and
from each station platform on a typical weekday in Sep 2024-Nov 2025.
As of Nov 2025, there were 70 TTC subway stations. Four stations serve two subway lines, and so are listed twice, once for each
subway line.
